New Dolch List 1.1
=================

Authors: Charles Browne and Brent Culligan
Citation supplied with the download:
Browne, C. & Culligan, B. (2024). New Dolch word list 1.10.

Project: https://www.newgeneralservicelist.com/new-dolch-list
Original download: https://www.newgeneralservicelist.com/s/NDL_11_stats.csv
Retrieved: 2026-10-25

words.csv is the unmodified official statistics download. It contains 874
unique words. The website's general description mentions 875 words, but the
version 1.1 download and its accompanying description specify 874.

License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
The complete license is included as LICENSE.txt in this directory.

Word Quest adaptation:
app/javascript/data/new_dolch_words.js selects 30 six-letter words and
30 seven- or eight-letter words from this source for beginner puzzles.
Word Quest contributors added original written clues and emoji selections,
assigned levels, reordered entries, and omitted the source's statistics.
That adapted dataset, including these clues and emoji selections, is also
distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. No endorsement by the original authors is implied.

The remaining source words are retained for review, not automatically enabled
in gameplay. These are young English-language learner vocabulary selections,
not certified US grade-level spelling assignments.
